name: Ron Yitzhak
title: Software Developer
summary: Software Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building production web applications with Angular and TypeScript. Designed, built, and runs a Node.js backend (Express, MongoDB, Redis) in daily production use: JWT auth with role-based access, MongoDB transactions, BullMQ job queues with scheduled push notifications, structured logging, integration tests against a real database, Docker, and CI/CD. Integrated Claude API features with structured outputs and server-side validation. Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code), focused on reliable, maintainable software.

highlights: Developed and maintained production web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
Worked with Node.js and Express to debug and fix issues in existing REST APIs and server-side functionality.
Integrated frontend applications with backend services through HTTP-based APIs and asynchronous communication.
Worked with HTTP, CORS, request/response handling, caching, cookies, and browser storage.
Collaborated with the development team on production features, bug fixes, and software maintenance.
Developed web and mobile applications, with a strong focus on mobile application development.
Implemented and maintained mobile application features based on project requirements.

projects.name: Home Management System
projects.description: Full-stack web app with a React frontend and a Node.js/Express REST API for managing household tasks.
highlights: JWT-based authentication, role-based authorization with household-level data isolation, request validation, and centralized error handling.
Web Push notifications (VAPID) that alert household members in real time when a task is completed.
MongoDB data models and database operations using Mongoose.
API integration tests with Jest and Supertest, and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that gates deployment to Render on passing tests.
API containerized with Docker, plus a Docker Compose local environment (API, MongoDB, Redis) with persistent volumes and live reload.

education.school: Ben Gurion University of the Negev
